app_identity.name: Wingman - Data Search Hub
app_identity.tagline: High-Performance Enterprise Data & Access Management Portal
app_identity.context: Internal Data Search, Bulk Lookup, File Storage & Scoped Access Portal

code_mono.usage: Record IDs, phone numbers, timestamps, API status codes, badges

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 for containers; gap-4 for grids; gap-2 for tight controls
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: px-4 py-6 sm:px-8 sm:py-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto
layout_and_spacing.navigation_pattern: Top sticky bar with brand logo, active route tabs, search shortcut, department scope selector, quick user menu & sign out
layout_and_spacing.density_mode: High Density Data Portal (Mode B) — clear tabular rows, compact padding, bulk action toolbars

page_hierarchy.title: Authentication & Password Management
key_elements: Language: Pure English UI
Sign in form with email & password + Remember Me
Sign up form with role requested & department select
Forgot Password local token request flow
Reset Password confirmation form with instant validation
Error & success toasts using Sonner

page_hierarchy.title: Executive Data & Activity Overview
key_elements: Instant aggregate stats: Total Records, Active Departments, Active Users, Pending Requests
Quick Action Cards: Instant Search, Bulk Lookup, Drag & Drop Upload
Department data distribution summary & quick file activity feed
Lightweight cached load to eliminate dashboard latency

page_hierarchy.title: Global Instant Search & Bulk Lookup
key_elements: Debounced instant search bar with clear filters (Department, Upload File, Field)
Bulk Lookup tab: Paste up to 500+ phone numbers/names with auto line-split
Paginated results table with column sorting and total matches count
Bulk selection header bar: Select All checkbox, Selected count, Bulk Delete button (Owner/Admin)

page_hierarchy.title: CSV File Storage & Upload Center
key_elements: Drag & Drop CSV upload zone with file size & delimiter detection
Real-time upload progress indicator with chunked processing
Duplicate records auto-skip summary (Inserted vs Skipped)
Uploaded Files History Table: File name, department, total rows, upload date, uploaded by, Download original, Delete file & contents, Re-upload button

page_hierarchy.title: Department Silo Management
key_elements: Create Department modal with name, description, access policy
Department cards/grid with total record count and user count
Select-all checkboxes for bulk department deletion (Owner only)
Edit department permissions dialog

page_hierarchy.title: User Administration & Role Access Control
key_elements: User Table with Name, Email, Role, Department Access tags, Status (Active/Disabled), Created Date
Create User button & modal (Direct admin provision)
Pending User Approvals tab with instant Approve / Reject
Disable / Enable toggle per user
Delete User action with confirmation modal (Owner/Admin)
Bulk User Management: Checkboxes + Select All -> Grant Access, Revoke Access, Replace Departments, Bulk Delete
Change Password trigger modal for self/admin reset

page_hierarchy.title: Strict Admin Blind-Approval Workflow
key_elements: Blind Mode Notice: Admin can only view and process user request queues
No access to underlying records, data files, or search queries (Least Privilege enforcement)
On Approval: New user automatically inherits the exact department scopes assigned to that Admin

component_guidelines.buttons: Use Shadcn button with variants: default (Cyan glow), outline (slate border), destructive (crimson solid), subtle (slate-800). Always include active hover effects.
component_guidelines.tables: Dense, crisp border-b border-slate-800 rows. Truncated long strings with copy tooltips. Sticky table headers. Checkbox column on left.
component_guidelines.bulk_toolbar: Floating or top-sticky bar appearing when items > 0 selected: displaying 'X items selected', Select All button, Clear selection, Bulk Delete, Bulk Access Grant.
component_guidelines.modals: Shadcn Dialog with overlay backdrop-blur-md, high contrast headers, explicitly styled action buttons, no transparent background on dialog content.
component_guidelines.inputs: Shadcn Input with slate-900 background, slate-700 border, cyan focus ring, clear placeholder text in English.
component_guidelines.toasts: Sonner toasts for all user-facing feedback (e.g. '50 records uploaded successfully', 'User account deleted', 'Password updated successfully').

motion_and_interactions.modal_entrance: framer-motion fade/scale transition or standard Tailwind opacity transition
motion_and_interactions.skeleton_loaders: Shadcn Skeleton pulses on search/dashboard data fetching to prevent layout shift
motion_and_interactions.progress_bars: Animated smooth width bar during file parsing and server upload

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_compliance: WCAG AA compliant contrast ratio (minimum 4.5:1 for standard text)
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements MUST feature data-testid attributes using kebab-case role naming (e.g. data-testid='sign-in-button', data-testid='user-select-all-checkbox', data-testid='bulk-delete-users-button', data-testid='file-upload-input', data-testid='forgot-password-link')

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all frontend components and backend toast/response messages are 100% in clear, professional English.
Implement full User Account CRUD (Create, Read, Update/Disable, Delete) in frontend and API routes.
Add File Storage Management: save uploaded CSVs to DB/disk, display uploaded file list with row counts, allow file deletion (which removes associated records), file download, and re-upload.
Optimize Search & Lookup performance with indexed MongoDB queries, pagination, and debounced input.
Support full bulk selection (Select All checkbox, bulk delete, bulk access management) across Users, Departments, and Search Records tables.
Provide Forgot Password and Reset Password flows with demo-safe token verification.
Maintain strict Admin blind-approval logic where Admin only sees user requests and cannot query search/records or upload files.
Ensure every button, input, checkbox, dialog, and row has proper data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop_rule: Avoid generic Vercel placeholders. Use crisp slate-950/900 surfaces with cyan-500 accent touches.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous internal padding (p-6/p-8) on cards to prevent text collision with borders.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: Never use transparent dropdowns or tooltips. Ensure high-visibility text on hover states.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing: All key controls MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes.
